item.brief:

Repository: quality-retry-budget (contains SPEC.md and retry_budget.py). Steps: read SPEC.md fully; implement every documented behaviour, error and boundary case in retry_budget.py while preserving the existing public API; add focused unit tests covering each specified error and boundary case (extend the existing test file rather than duplicating basics); use only the Python standard library; run the test suite and make sure it passes; commit the work on the local branch with a clear message. Do not push. Keep functions under 60 lines and follow the repository's existing style.

pr.body:
Files: retry_budget.py (_require_int, _backoff_ms, retry_delay), test_retry_budget.py (new classes RetryValidation, RetryAttemptLimit, RetryBackoff, RetryBudget; existing basics unchanged).

Approach: validation first (built-in int only, minimums), then attempt >= max_attempts -> None, backoff = min(cap, base << (attempt-1)) with shortcut returning cap once attempt-1 >= cap.bit_length() so huge attempts never build big powers of two; zero base or cap gives 0. Retry-After is an uncapped floor. Retry rejected when elapsed+delay >= budget; the wait is never shortened.

Checks: unittest 32/32 OK; random cross-check vs spec formula OK; before on base stub 32 errors.

Assumptions: type checks use `type(v) is int` so bool and float are rejected with ValueError; subclasses of int are also rejected.

Review: one reviewer (agt_01M8AEKZDN326ZPR9AS2NED97D) passed head f770f08 with no findings; risk medium confirmed.
